examples.question: What is the least common media type in all tracks?
examples.issue_sql:
SELECT MediaTypeId
FROM Track
WHERE MediaTypeId IN (
    SELECT MediaTypeId
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track)
)
ORDER BY MediaTypeId ASC
LIMIT 1;
examples.train_gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM MEDIATYPE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId  =  T2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY T2.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

samples.final_sql:
SELECT MediaTypeId
FROM Track
WHERE MediaTypeId IN (
    SELECT MediaTypeId
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track)
)
ORDER BY MediaTypeId ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.Name FROM MediaType AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY T1.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT Name FROM MediaType GROUP BY Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT t1.Name FROM TRACK AS t1 JOIN MediaType AS t2 ON t1.MediaTypeId = t2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY t1.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

examples.question: What are the name and the nationality of the host of the highest age?
examples.issue_sql:
SELECT host.Name, host.Nationality
FROM host
WHERE host.Age = (
    SELECT MAX(host.Age)
    FROM host
) AND host.Host_ID IN (
    SELECT host.Host_ID
    FROM host
    JOIN party_host ON host.Host_ID = party_host.Host_ID
    GROUP BY host.Host_ID
    ORDER BY party_host.Is_Main_in_Charge = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
);
examples.train_gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  Nationality FROM HOST ORDER BY Age DESC LIMIT 1

samples.final_sql: SELECT h.Name, h.Nationality FROM host AS h JOIN party_host AS ph ON h.Host_ID = ph.Host_ID WHERE h.Age = (SELECT MAX(Age) FROM host) ORDER BY ph.Is_Main_in_Charge DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.Name, T1.Nationality FROM host AS T1 JOIN party_host AS T2 ON T1.Host_ID = T2.Host_ID WHERE T1.Age = (SELECT MAX(Age) FROM host)

examples.question: Show the station name with greatest number of trains.
examples.issue_sql:
SELECT station.Name
FROM station
JOIN train ON station.Station_ID = train.Train_ID
WHERE train.Service = 'Main' AND station.Number_of_Platforms = (SELECT MAX(station.Number_of_Platforms) FROM station);
examples.train_gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM train_station AS T1 JOIN station AS T2 ON T1.station_id  =  T2.station_id GROUP BY T1.station_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

samples.final_sql: SELECT station.Name FROM station JOIN train_station ON station.Station_ID = train_station.Station_ID GROUP BY station.Name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT train_station.Train_ID) DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Find the name and email for the users who have more than one follower.
